sourceDesc.bibl: Boas, Franz (1901): The Eskimo of Baffin Land and Hudson Bay. From notes collected by George Comer, James S. Mutch, and E. J. Peck. New York: AMNH (Bulletin of the American Museum of Natural History, 15,I). Quot. pp. 304-305.

projectDesc.p: Text digitized and encoded for use in the Forager Folklore Database.

body.p: It is said that a giant used to bail out of the sea with his hands the people and their boats. Then he put the people into a large box; and, as he watched it all the time, they {305} were unable to escape. It is also said of him that he caught whales just as one would catch sculp ins, by straddling a fiord and fishing in this manner.[[See p. 196.]]
